title: Sandia Verification and Validation Challenge Problem: A PCMM-Based Approach to Assessing Prediction Credibility
venue: Journal of Verification Validation and Uncertainty Quantification
first_author_affiliation: Multi-Physics Modeling and Simulation, Sandia National Laboratories, P.O. Box 969, MS 9042, Livermore, CA 94550-0969 e-mail:

corresponding_authors.name: Lauren L. Beghini
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Multi-Physics Modeling and Simulation, Sandia National Laboratories, P.O. Box 969, MS 9042, Livermore, CA 94550-0969 e-mail:

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了基于PCMM的预测可信度评估框架，包含代理模型和不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的验证与确认。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or surrogate modeling for FEA in biomedical design; it focuses on general V&V methodology for computational models.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立计算模型预测可信度的系统评估框架
summary_zh.method: 采用PCMM组织证据收集，结合代理模型和多网格精度降低计算成本
summary_zh.result: 展示了灵敏度分析、校准、验证和UQ如何支持PCMM评估
summary_zh.validation: 通过Sandia挑战问题的仿真案例进行方法演示

summary_en.motivation: To establish a systematic framework for assessing the credibility of computational model predictions through verification and validation activities.
summary_en.method: The predictive capability maturity model (PCMM) is used to organize evidence collection, while response surface surrogates and multiple mesh fidelities address computational cost.
summary_en.result: The approach demonstrates how sensitivity analysis, model calibration, validation, and uncertainty quantification support PCMM assessments.
summary_en.validation: The methodology is demonstrated on the Sandia verification and validation challenge problem using simulation cases.

title: Finite Element Analysis of Porous Medical Grade Cobalt Chromium Alloy Structures Produced by Selective Laser Melting
first_author_affiliation: Universiti Malaysia Pahang

corresponding_authors.name: Saiful Anwar Che Ghani
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Universiti Malaysia Pahang

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备的多孔CoCr合金的有限元分析和力学性能，与用户的方向（AM生物医学材料）直接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration, which are key aspects for implant performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过有限元预测SLM多孔CoCr合金的力学性能，减少实验成本。
summary_zh.method: 设计60%-80%孔隙率的多孔立方体结构，使用ANSYS进行有限元分析，并与实验对比。
summary_zh.result: 有限元结果在等效应力、应变和变形上与实验吻合较好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验压缩测试验证有限元预测的弹性模量。

summary_en.motivation: To predict effective mechanical properties of SLM-fabricated porous CoCr alloy structures via finite element analysis, reducing the need for extensive physical testing.
summary_en.method: Cubical porous structures with volume porosity from 60% to 80% were designed and analyzed using ANSYS 14.0, and results were compared with experimental compression tests.
summary_en.result: FE predictions of equivalent stress, strain, and deformation showed reasonable agreement with experimental data for the studied porosity range.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests on SLM-fabricated CoCr porous specimens were used to validate the finite element model predictions.

title: Dimensional Accuracy Study of Open Cellular Structure CoCrMo Alloy Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting Process
first_author_affiliation: Universiti Malaysia Pahang

corresponding_authors.name: Zahrul Adnan Mat Taib
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Universiti Malaysia Pahang

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及SLM制造CoCrMo多孔结构的尺寸精度，但未报道力学性能、疲劳或骨整合。
why_not_core: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no connection to stress shielding or stiffness matching, no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备CoCrMo开放多孔结构的尺寸精度。
summary_zh.method: 设计不同孔隙率(0%-80%)样品并测量收缩率。
summary_zh.result: 80%孔隙率样品收缩率达2.10%。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量比较设计尺寸与打印尺寸。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the dimensional accuracy of open cellular CoCrMo structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples with designed porosities from 0% to 80% were manufactured and shrinkage was measured.
summary_en.result: The maximum shrinkage of 2.10% was observed for the 80% porosity sample.
summary_en.validation: Comparison of designed and as-built dimensions through experimental measurement.

corresponding_authors.name: Mohd Yusof Baharuddin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Cyberjaya University College of Medical Sciences

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及股骨柄设计、有限元分析和微动评估，但方法较为基础，缺乏先进的接触力学和患者特异性建模。
why_not_core: Does not include detailed contact/friction modeling, patient-specific geometry, or comparison with intact femur; validation is limited to a single prototype.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低非骨水泥股骨柄制造成本，惠及发展中国家患者。
summary_zh.method: 基于逆向工程和有限元分析设计股骨柄，采用熔模铸造法制造316L不锈钢原型。
summary_zh.result: 最大von Mises应力66.88 MPa，微动4.73 μm，安全因子2.39。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过有限元模拟验证，无实验或临床数据。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the cost of uncemented femoral stems for patients in developing countries through a low-cost fabrication process.
summary_en.method: Designed a femoral stem using reverse engineering and finite element analysis, and fabricated a prototype from 316L stainless steel via investment casting.
summary_en.result: The finite element analysis showed a maximum von Mises stress of 66.88 MPa proximally, micromotion of 4.73 μm, and a safety factor of 2.39 against endosteal fracture.
summary_en.validation: Validation was limited to simulation results without experimental or clinical confirmation.

title: Multilevel Monte Carlo Finite Element Method for A Stochastic Optimal Control Problem
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层蒙特卡罗方法可应用于生物力学领域的昂贵仿真不确定性量化，提高采样效率。
why_not_core: No surrogate modeling, no constraints handling, and no biomechanics/implant application.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低随机最优控制问题求解的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 利用多层蒙特卡罗方法结合最优样本量分配进行高效计算
summary_zh.result: 数值验证表明该方法优于传统蒙特卡罗方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过椭圆随机偏微分方程和最优控制算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of solving stochastic optimal control problems with log-normal coefficients.
summary_en.method: A multilevel Monte Carlo finite element method is implemented with optimal sample sizes derived for each level.
summary_en.result: Numerical results on both elliptic SPDEs and the control problem demonstrate improved efficiency over standard Monte Carlo.
summary_en.validation: Validated via numerical benchmarks on elliptic SPDEs and a stochastic optimal control problem.

title: Facility Deployment Decisions through Warp Optimizaton of Regressed Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程回归构建代理模型优化部署决策，可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的代理模型优化，但领域差异大。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on nuclear fuel cycle deployment, not implant/biomechanics design; no FEA, no explicit constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification emphasis, and the method is demonstrated on a non-biomechanical simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 快速确定满足核燃料循环需求的设施部署时间表。
summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程回归预测生产曲线，并基于动态时间规整距离优化部署方案。
summary_zh.result: 算法在5-10次迭代内收敛，误差小于总可部署产量的1%。

summary_en.motivation: To rapidly determine facility deployment schedules that meet a given fuel cycle demand within low-fidelity simulators.
summary_en.method: Gaussian process regression models predict production curves as functions of time and number of facilities, and dynamic time warping measures distance to the demand curve for optimization.
summary_en.result: The method converges to a distance less than 1% of total deployable production within five to ten iterations.
summary_en.validation: The methodology is demonstrated on a representative once-through nuclear fuel cycle simulation.

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用贝叶斯方法结合高斯过程元模型进行软组织粘弹性参数估计，其方法可迁移至植入物力学设计中的不确定性量化与代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on soft tissue viscoelasticity characterization in ARF imaging, not on implant design, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决ARF成像中软组织粘弹性参数反演的不确定性问题
summary_zh.method: 基于贝叶斯公式和高斯过程元模型替代有限元模拟进行参数概率分布估计
summary_zh.result: 贝叶斯方法在存在大不确定性的情况下仍能有效估计时间常数概率分布
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟与单自由度模型对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the uncertainty in inverse characterization of soft tissue viscoelasticity from acoustic radiation force imaging.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian formulation with Gaussian process metamodeling is used to approximate expensive finite element simulations and estimate probability distributions of viscoelastic parameters.
summary_en.result: The Bayesian approach provides efficient and robust estimation of the time constant distribution even under large model parameter uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical simulations and comparison with single degree-of-freedom models.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔钛填充可降解镁在模拟体液中的力学降解行为，涉及多孔结构力学性能，但未涉及LPBF制造、疲劳测试或应力屏蔽匹配。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no fatigue testing, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, and no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究多孔钛填充镁在模拟体液中的力学性能退化
summary_zh.method: 制备多孔钛与镁复合结构，在Hanks溶液中浸泡后测试力学性能
summary_zh.result: 镁填充提高了初始强度但降解后强度下降
summary_zh.validation: 通过浸泡实验和力学测试验证降解行为

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical degradation of porous titanium with entangled structure filled with biodegradable magnesium in simulated body fluid.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium scaffolds were fabricated with entangled structure and infiltrated with magnesium, then immersed in Hanks' solution for various periods followed by mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Magnesium filling enhanced initial compressive strength but led to significant strength loss after degradation due to magnesium corrosion.
summary_en.validation: In vitro immersion tests and post-degradation mechanical compression tests were conducted.

title: A sparse grid method for Bayesian uncertainty quantification with application to large eddy simulation turbulence models
relevance_to_user: 该论文将稀疏网格替代模型用于贝叶斯不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物约束或优化。
why_not_core: This paper applies to fluid dynamics (LES turbulence) rather than solid mechanics or implant design, and does not address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少贝叶斯推断中昂贵LES模拟的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 构建自适应稀疏网格替代模型加速似然函数评估
summary_zh.result: 显著减少LES执行次数而不损失后验估计精度
summary_zh.validation: 二维圆柱绕流Smagorinsky模型数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of Bayesian uncertainty quantification for computationally expensive large eddy simulations.
summary_en.method: An adaptive hierarchical sparse grid surrogate is constructed for the forward model output, enabling rapid likelihood evaluation.
summary_en.result: The approach drastically reduces the number of costly LES executions while maintaining accuracy in posterior probability estimation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical demonstration on the Smagorinsky model of two-dimensional flow around a cylinder at sub-critical Reynolds number.

why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, nor does it address multi-objective optimization or constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高随机有限元分析中不确定性量化的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 利用功能主成分分析构建降阶模型，高效传播输入不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算成本。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证方法的准确性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To improve computational efficiency of uncertainty quantification in stochastic finite element analysis.
summary_en.method: A reduced-order model based on functional principal component analysis is constructed to efficiently propagate input uncertainties.
summary_en.result: The method significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark examples are used to validate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approach.

title: A Bayesian framework for functional calibration of expensive computational models through non-isometric matching
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯非等距匹配方法可用于昂贵仿真模型的校准，未来可应用于种植体或生物力学的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraints in optimization, nor does it apply the method to implant or biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵计算模型在样本有限时的功能校准问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯非等距匹配法，用动态高斯过程替代原模型并组合优化构建先验。
summary_zh.result: 预测精度优于或持平现有校准框架。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To calibrate expensive computational models with limited evaluations by addressing functional calibration and identifiability issues.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian non-isometric matching approach is proposed, replacing the computational model with a dynamic Gaussian process and using combinatorial optimization to construct priors.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms or is comparable to existing calibration frameworks in prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic and real datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.

summary_en.motivation: To address stress shielding-induced bone resorption and implant loosening in hip prostheses by developing porous titanium structures.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium samples with a regular mesoscale pore pattern were fabricated using Selective Laser Sintering and subjected to continuous and incremental compression tests.
summary_en.result: Mechanical properties of the porous structures were characterized, and a testing protocol for different porosity geometries was established.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation was performed through compression testing, including both continuous and incremental loading to observe yielding.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on time-dependent reliability analysis with epistemic uncertainty, but does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate for stress shielding, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决时间相关可靠性分析中数据与模型不确定性对结果的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯方法建模认知不确定性，构建条件可靠度指标的代理模型。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the effects of data and model uncertainty on time-dependent reliability analysis results.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian approach models epistemic uncertainty in random variables and stochastic processes, and a surrogate model for the conditional reliability index is built to avoid double-loop computation.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model enables efficient uncertainty quantification without evaluating the original limit-state function.
summary_en.validation: The method is demonstrated on a mathematical example and an engineering application.

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了在虚拟手术血流动力学预测中结合贝叶斯推断、Kriging代理模型和稀疏网格随机配点进行不确定性量化的完整流程，其方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的不确定性传播与代理建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 临床数据不确定性导致虚拟手术预测结果不可靠，需量化预测置信区间。
summary_zh.method: 结合贝叶斯参数估计、Kriging代理模型和稀疏网格随机配点，实现从临床数据到血流动力学预测的不确定性传播。

summary_en.motivation: Clinical input uncertainties undermine the reliability of virtual surgery predictions, necessitating a framework to quantify confidence in simulation outputs.
summary_en.method: A methodology combining Bayesian parameter estimation with a Kriging surrogate for inverse problem and sparse grid stochastic collocation for forward uncertainty propagation is proposed.

summary_en.result: Complete defect bridging occurred within eight weeks, and after twelve weeks the femora regained torsional strength exceeding twice the original.
summary_en.validation: The study used in vivo µCT, histology, and ex vivo torsion testing in a rat model.

summary_en.result: RTO demonstrates superior computational efficiency and sampling quality compared to the Metropolis adjusted Langevin algorithm.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic examples from electrical impedance tomography.

summary_en.motivation: To construct linear parametric models that rigorously quantify the distribution of an output variable given input-output data.
summary_en.method: Optimal random predictor models are computed via a sequence of optimization programs, with prediction reliability bounded using Scenario Optimization Theory.
summary_en.result: The models yield the tightest output ranges containing most observations and can eliminate outlier effects.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical validation under stationary independent data and convex optimization assumptions provides rigorous reliability bounds.

summary_en.result: The PCE surrogate drastically speeds up the inference of unknown thermal conductivities while maintaining accurate posterior approximations.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高含PDE系统不确定性分析的效率，避免全局求解。
summary_zh.method: 将系统分解为局部组件，离线独立分析，在线通过重要性采样和POD降阶模型组装全局结果。
summary_zh.result: 实现了高效的全局不确定性分析，无需在线全局PDE求解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法的准确性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of uncertainty analysis for PDE-governed systems by avoiding expensive global solves.
summary_en.method: Decomposes the system into local components, performs offline independent UQ, and assembles global results online via importance sampling and a POD reduced model.
summary_en.result: Achieves efficient global UQ without online global PDE solves, demonstrated on numerical benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems, comparing accuracy and computational cost against full-order solutions.
